title: Ashbury Rewards Points Commerce: Buying Points for One's Own Account
content:
A member may buy points for their own Ashbury Rewards account, paying with their own card; buying is the member's own decision and payment, made by the member personally. A member who asks to buy the most points they are allowed buys them in one purchase.

## Conditions of the result

- The purchase allowance is fixed only after every stay credited at an elite tier whose base points stand on the account carries its elite bonus transaction.
- The purchase allowance is not fixed until the stay of the latest base points transaction on the account carries its welcome points transaction whenever the tier in effect by that stay's check-out date gives it a welcome amount above zero.
- The purchase allowance is fixed only once every credited stay whose folio carries an eligible-spend adjustment posted after its base points carries a stay credit reversal naming its base points transaction.

## Conditions of every purchase

- Points may be bought only once the account has been open for the tier's minimum number of days since enrolment. The age of the account is counted in whole calendar days from the enrolment date, which is day zero; a purchase on the day the minimum is reached is allowed.
- The points bought in the twelve months before the handling date, including the purchase being made, may not exceed the purchase allowance; a request beyond it is reduced to the remaining allowance or declined, never split across another member's account.
- A member makes at most one purchase per calendar day.
- Purchased points are not refundable when the tier's setting makes them non-refundable.
- Points are bought only for a membership whose status is active.

## Capability

`buy_points_b3668dab` is the member's own purchase: the member buys Ashbury Rewards points for their own account and pays with their card. One call records one points purchase transaction of source `points_purchase` with the points bought and the price charged, dated on the purchase date given, and adds the points to the points balance of the membership. Purchased points are visible at once in the account activity and balance.

## Invocation

This is a customer-side tool: the customer themselves runs it. The agent unlocks it for the customer with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `buy_points_b3668dab`, and the customer then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loyalty_member_id` | Reference number of the member's own Ashbury Rewards membership, as read out by the agent from the membership lookup | Identifier |
| `points` | Points bought, as stated by the agent | Whole number of points, always positive; integer, no decimals, no thousands separators |
| `purchase_amount_usd` | Price charged for the points before tax, in USD, as stated by the agent | Plain number with 2 decimal places, such as 1234.50, no currency sign; stored rounded half to even to 2 decimal places |
| `posted_date` | Calendar date of the purchase, which is today's date as stated by the agent | YYYY-MM-DD |

## Return

A dictionary string with `transaction_id` (reference number of the purchase transaction), `loyalty_member_id` (membership credited), `points` (integer points bought), `purchase_amount_usd` (USD charged, 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (purchase date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (points balance once the points are added). A returned `transaction_id` means the purchase is complete.
